name: tetrilaunch
description: Tetrilaunch — a neon-arcade physics cannon puzzle. Capacitor port (web / Android / iOS).

scripts.cap:add:android: cap add android && npm run patch:android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && npm run verify:store && cap sync android && npm run patch:android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && npm run verify:store && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
